## Historical audit: S0046

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/quota_restored_20261103/retired/results/r2/sceneevolve_cli/C1/test/commons_199974832/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this original file; offsets are half-open character ranges within each JSONL observation.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, line 1 [0,9035) | The assigned goal was an editable SceneAct reconstruction of an indoor photograph, with separate meshes, materials, camera and lighting, followed by visual correction. This is the requested goal, not evidence that those elements were built. The image is referenced by path but its contents are not present in the supplied observations. |
| Student `codex_session`, line 2 [0,2634) | A fresh, read-only CLI session was launched with the image argument. It failed with exit code 1 after approximately 8.79 seconds; the record reports zero tool calls. Actual model and underlying model-turn count are unknown. |
| Student `model_error`, line 3 [0,552); `scene_error`, line 4 [0,1614) | The wrapper reported the student exit and propagated the exception through `runtime.ask`. A stderr log is named but its contents are not supplied, so the underlying cause is unknown. |

**Outcome and validation.** This is a **technical interruption**, not demonstrated algorithmic failure or partial geometric correctness. The supplied trajectory contains no student program, scene build, render, visual comparison, score, or successful submission. It therefore provides no evidence of actual changes or an empty patch. No autonomous exploration is visible; the session reports no tool calls, although unexposed inference activity cannot be ruled out.

**Scene-specific checks.** Multiple objects, their materials or textures, part connections, pose, camera, lighting, and render quality are all **unverified**. Their inclusion in the instructions does not establish their presence or correctness. No image is visible in this audit, so neither the reference scene nor a reconstruction can be independently inspected.

**Teacher input.** No teacher message, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, or execution is shown. The reconstruction procedure in the student system prompt was delivered as an instruction, but it is not evidence of separate teacher feedback or its adoption.

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, a failed model invocation and missing render cannot support a quality assessment; inspect the actual error before diagnosing or repairing a build. Task-specific hypotheses about scene geometry, framing, or materials remain unresolved. The unavailable stderr prevents determining why the CLI exited, and the trace does not establish any later outcome.
